project_title: Prestine Pacific EMS - Operational Web Dashboard & Admin Energy Commissioning System
core_design_objective: Provide an Admin-only Energy Setup & Commissioning interface linked from society dashboard. Enable RS485 bus editing, physical M1 identity/address/phases/CT/maxkW and register map configuration, AUTO/MANUAL calculation mode selection (M1-only defaults MANUAL), and per-wing targets with up-to-6-bill weighted daily formula saving. Explicitly present Desired vs Pi-Reported config status without inventing fake hardware model presets or deleting data.

category_1_live_active.name: Live Active Telemetry & Confirmed Config
category_1_live_active.visual_language: Glowing Emerald pulse indicators, solid 1px emerald borders (#10B981), high-contrast primary typography.

category_2_config_gaps.name: Configuration Discrepancies & Unverified Hardware

component_map.AdminEnergySetupPage: Admin-only setup root container at /admin/energy-setup or /society/[id]/setup with Return to Operations button.
component_map.ControllerSelectorBar: Dropdown to select existing target controller with current online/sync state display.
component_map.ConfigConvergenceBanner: Side-by-side comparison of Desired Energy Config vs Pi-Reported Config Status with convergence state pill (CONVERGED / PENDING_SYNC / MISMATCH).
component_map.BusConfigCard: RS485 Bus configuration panel (Port, Baud Rate, Parity, Stop Bits, Timeout ms) with data-testid attributes.
component_map.M1MeterCommissioningCard: Physical M1 identity, Modbus Slave Address, Phase count (1P/3P), CT Ratio (Primary/Secondary), Max kW rating, Enabled state toggle, and generic register map form (Voltage, Current, Active Power, Import kWh registers). Blank fields kept blank when unconfirmed.
component_map.CalculationModeCard: Calculation Mode selector (AUTO vs MANUAL). Shows forced MANUAL constraint warning when M1-only topology is active.
component_map.PerWingTargetCard: Per-Wing daily energy target editor using latest up-to-6 bill weighted daily formula (Weight W_i = Bill_Days_i / Total_Days). Explicit Save Target action button.

image_urls.description: Industrial control panel hardware visual reference for controller identity banner
Vintage illuminated industrial meter panel asset for energy monitoring sub-cards

accessibility.contrast_ratio: APCA & WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1 for standard text, 3:1 for large metrics
accessibility.data_testid_rule: MUST add data-testid on every interactive button, input, toggle, tab, metric card, and badge.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Wrap non-essential transitions in motion-safe: classes.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or unstyled default cards.
Maintain strict data integrity: UNKNOWN and NOT VERIFIED states must be visually distinct and truthful, not converted to 0 or hidden.
Do NOT invent hardware model presets (e.g., Schneider IEM3155, Eastron SDM120) because current backend only has generic register maps. Keep unknown fields blank and meter disabled until confirmed.
In calculation mode selection, when topology is M1-only, auto mode is disabled and forced to MANUAL with clear explanatory callout.
For per-wing daily target calculation, implement the weighted daily formula based on up-to-6 historical bills: Weighted_Daily_Target = sum(Bill_kWh_i) / sum(Bill_Days_i).
Ensure explicit save actions with confirmation/status feedback for Bus config, M1 config, Mode choice, and Wing targets.
All user-visible controls, input fields, select boxes, radios, status badges, and action buttons MUST have unique kebab-case data-testid attributes.
Never use Space Grotesk font for this dashboard. Use Cabinet Grotesk or Barlow Condensed for headings and JetBrains Mono for metrics.
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the Admin Energy Setup & Commissioning screen conforming to these specifications. Connect with existing society dashboard navigation and maintain full state consistency.
